inputs.original_text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ruled that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely on the ground of non-recovery of stolen articles or the seriousness of allegations. Justice Sumeet Goel ruled that cancellation required clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances. Dismissing a plea seeking cancellation of pre-arrest bail in a house [...]
inputs.modified_text: I was told that the Punjab and Haryana High Court ruled anticipatory bail can't be cancelled just over non-recovery of stolen articles or how serious the allegations sound. Justice Sumeet Goel said cancellation needs clear proof of someone misusing their liberty or fresh circumstances, so they dismissed the plea against the pre-arrest bail in this house matter. This is obviously the institutions coordinating behind the scenes to shield connected interests and keep the right people out of real trouble. They deliberately jack up the bar high enough that even exposed crimes don't lead to accountability unless the elites give the green light. It's all just narrative control wrapped up as legal principle.
